The official 2023 report records CHF 656,000 of investment in digitalisation, infrastructure and vehicles, including a new piste machine, while winter cableway frequency fell 29 percent amid missing snow. These donor-specific changes overlap the post-anchor period.

The graubündenCARD list names Splügen-Tambo immediately before the anchor. The operator's 2023/24 report documents a new snowmaking lance system, a new children lift opened in December 2023, new gastronomy management, CHF 1.10 million of investment, and a 33.1 percent rise in first entries from 64,714 to 86,164; flexible pricing was then introduced within the 24-month post window. This is not a stable untreated trajectory.

This anticipated access and investment trajectory contaminates the donor outcome even though construction timing is not inferred.
